hooks.name: Syntax-check the deck
hooks.description: After any JS file is saved, fail loudly on a syntax error before it reaches a browser.

hooks.name: Write the session log
hooks.description: Appends one human-readable line to DEVLOG.md at the end of every session. This log is the raw material for the Kiro write-up in the submission.

action.prompt: Append one line to DEVLOG.md in the format `YYYY-MM-DD | files touched | what actually changed | what I (the human) rejected or overrode`. Keep it to one line of plain text, no headings, and do not restate the diff. If nothing changed, do not write.
